evidence.location: Article 3 — Dried, diluted, processed and compound food
evidence.text: Article 3 Dried, diluted, processed and compound food 1. Where no specific Union maximum levels are set out in Annex I for food which is dried, diluted, processed or compound food (i.e. composed of more than one ingredient), the following aspects shall be taken into account when applying the maximum levels set out in Annex I to such food: (a) changes of the concentration of the contaminant caused by drying or dilution processes; (b) changes of the concentration of the contaminant caused by processing; (c) the relative proportions of the ingredients in the product; (d) the analytical limit of quantification. 2. Where the competent authority carries out an official control, the food business operator shall provide and justify the specific concentration, dilution or processing factors for the drying, diluting or processing operations concerned or the specific concentration, dilution or processing factors for the dried, diluted, processed or compound food concerned as well as the proportion of ingredients for mixing operations concerned. Where the food business operator does not provide the necessary concentration, dilution or processing factor or where the competent authority deems that factor inappropriate in view of the justification given, the competent authority shall itself define that factor, based on the available information and with the objective of maximum protection of human health. 3. Where no specific Union maximum levels for food for infants and young children are set out in Annex I, Member States may provide for stricter maximum levels for such food.

Article 1 Prior notification of consignments 1. The operator responsible for a consignment falling within the categories of animals and goods referred to in Article 47(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 shall give prior notification, to the competent authority of the border control post of first arrival into the Union, at least one working day before the expected arrival of the consignment. 2. By way of derogation from paragraph 1, where logistical constraints prevent compliance with the time limit set out in that paragraph, the competent authorities of the border control posts may apply a period of prior notification of at least four hours before the expected arrival of the consignment. 3. By way of derogation from paragraph 1, the competent authorities of border control posts designated for imports of unprocessed logs and sawn and chipped wood in accordance with Article 4 of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/1012 may apply a period of prior notification of up to five working days before the expected arrival of such consignments.

evidence.text: Article 2 Entry into force and application This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union . It shall apply as from 14 December 2019.

Article 17 Responsibilities 1. Food and feed business operators at all stages of production, processing and distribution within the businesses under their control shall ensure that foods or feeds satisfy the requirements of food law which are relevant to their activities and shall verify that such requirements are met. 2. Member States shall enforce food law, and monitor and verify that the relevant requirements of food law are fulfilled by food and feed business operators at all stages of production, processing and distribution. For that purpose, they shall maintain a system of official controls and other activities as appropriate to the circumstances, including public communication on food and feed safety and risk, food and feed safety surveillance and other monitoring activities covering all stages of production, processing and distribution. Member States shall also lay down the rules on measures and penalties applicable to infringements of food and feed law. The measures and penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

## Short answer

Aflatoxin B1 being detected does **not** by itself establish that the dried figs exceed the EU maximum. The supplied Regulation (EU) 2023/915 table sets **6.0 μg/kg for B1** and **10.0 μg/kg for the sum of aflatoxins** in dried figs; the measured concentration and, for the sum, the required result are unknown. (2023/915, Annex I, Table 3, row 1.1.3 [E84bba6f619])

## Evidence-supported requirements

- **Maximum levels:** For dried figs, B1 must be assessed against 6.0 μg/kg and the sum of B1, B2, G1 and G2 against 10.0 μg/kg. The sum is assessed using lower-bound concentrations, treating results below the limit of quantification as zero. The table says these limits also apply to products consisting of dried figs as the only ingredient or containing at least 80% dried figs. (2023/915, Annex I, Table 3, row 1.1.3 [E84bba6f619])
- **Other processed or compound products:** Where no specific Union maximum is set, applying the Annex I limits requires taking account of concentration changes from drying, dilution or processing, ingredient proportions and the analytical limit of quantification. During an official control, the food business operator must provide and justify the relevant factors and mixing proportions; if it does not, or the authority finds its justification inappropriate, the authority defines the factor based on available information to protect health. (2023/915, Article 3(1)–(2) [Eb2674e6c28])
- **Sampling and analysis:** For foods listed under Regulation (EU) 2019/1793 because of possible mycotoxin contamination, sampling and analysis are to follow Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/2782. (2019/1793, Article 3(a) [E6755b594ef])
- **Operator and authority responsibilities:** Food business operators must ensure and verify compliance with food-law requirements relevant to their activities; Member States enforce those requirements through official controls. (178/2002, Article 17 [E32d56f6d3a])
- **Import consequences if non-compliance is established:** A consignment entering the Union that does not comply with applicable rules is to be detained and refused entry. (2017/625, Article 66(1) [Ebcbbe77002]) The excerpt does not establish that this shipment has been officially found non-compliant.
- **Türkiye-specific checks in the supplied version:** The supplied Regulation (EU) 2019/1793 Annex II entry lists Türkiye-origin dried figs and specified fig products for aflatoxins and ochratoxin A, with a 30% frequency of identity and physical checks. That is a control frequency, not a permissible contamination level. The excerpt identifies its consolidated version as dated 2026-06-30. (2019/1793, Annex II, Section 1, logical row 14 [Effd100d7a6])
- **Prior notification, if applicable:** For consignments within Article 47(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625, the operator responsible must notify the competent authority at the first-arrival border control post at least one working day before expected arrival; the authority may allow at least four hours where logistical constraints prevent that deadline. Whether this shipment falls within Article 47(1) is not established by the supplied excerpts. (2019/1013, Article 1 [E2015741215])

## Facts and law to verify

- Obtain the analytical result in μg/kg, identify whether it is for B1 alone or the aflatoxin sum, and confirm the method’s limit of quantification. Without these, exceedance cannot be determined against the applicable limits. [E84bba6f619]
- Confirm the exact product, processing and ingredient composition—especially whether it is dried figs alone, contains at least 80% dried figs, or is another processed or compound product—and obtain justified processing/concentration factors where Article 3 requires them. [E84bba6f619] [Eb2674e6c28]
- Confirm the lot’s import/market stage, whether an official control or non-compliance decision exists, and whether the shipment’s CN/TARIC classification and intended use fall within the Türkiye entry described in the supplied 2019/1793 text. [Effd100d7a6] [Ebcbbe77002]
- The frozen excerpts do **not** establish the present legal effect or current version of the Türkiye-specific 2019/1793 entry: its stated consolidation date is 2026-06-30. They also do not establish that the shipment meets the Article 47(1) condition for the notification rule. [Effd100d7a6] [E2015741215]

## Practical next steps

1. Secure the full lab report and compare the relevant result with the dried-fig B1 and sum limits; do not treat detection alone as an exceedance. [E84bba6f619]
2. Document product composition and any processing factors; provide and justify them to the competent authority if an official control requires this. [Eb2674e6c28]
3. Before relying on the stated Türkiye inspection frequency, verify the currently applicable 2019/1793 text, product classification and any applicable border-control requirements. The supplied snapshot alone cannot confirm present legal effect. [Effd100d7a6]
4. If the competent authority determines the consignment is non-compliant, follow its decision; Article 66 provides for detention and refusal of entry. [Ebcbbe77002]
